about: How an ops-request's verb ENDED, one row per execute record shape (design b7bb1625, backlog 50a1578f). Read by BOTH classifiers: boss-jobs ops_execution.rs (the_matrix_is_how_this_classifier_reads) and apps/web/src/it/ops-execution.ts (ops-execution.test.ts), so the web reads every record the way the CLI, the regions and the judges do. A fact that lives twice gets an equality test (CLAUDE.md 9a): this file is that test's one copy of the cases.
